post.summary: Fetch the model list from a provider's /v1/models endpoint
post.description:
Proxy a GET against the upstream OpenAI-compatible ``/v1/models``.

Browsers can't call third-party LLM endpoints directly (CORS), so the
UI's "获取" button posts here and the manager performs the request
server-side. Auth resolution order:

1. ``body.api_key`` (caller-supplied, plaintext)
2. ``body.provider_id``: load the stored key for that provider, but
   only if it belongs to the caller's tenant — otherwise treat it as
   not found to avoid leaking secrets across tenants.
3. No key — many local providers (vLLM, Ollama) don't require one.

post.summary: Proxy a chat completion request to a registered provider
post.description:
Proxy OpenAI-compatible chat completions through the manager.

The browser only sends ``provider_id`` and ``model``. The manager resolves
the provider's stored ``base_url`` and ``api_key`` server-side, so saved
secrets are never exposed to the frontend. The response is normalized to
SSE because the comparison UI renders each model incrementally.

post.summary: Stream deployment of selected providers to selected NineClaw instances
post.description:
Push the selected providers + main model to each target nineclaw,
streaming progress via Server-Sent Events.

Sequential per instance — the user-facing wizard renders each event as
"deploying" → "deployed"/"failed" so they should arrive one-by-one
instead of all at once. On failure of a single instance we emit a
``failed`` event and continue with the next.

Event payload (per instance)::

    { "instance_id": str,
      "name": str,
      "status": "pending" | "deploying" | "deployed" | "failed",
      "error": str | null }

A final ``done`` event terminates the stream.

get.summary: Stream concurrent health probes for the tenant's providers
get.description:
Run an HTTP-GET health probe against every provider's ``base_url``
and stream the result as SSE.

Probes run concurrently (bounded by ``_HEALTH_CONCURRENCY``) so a slow
provider can't hold up the rest. Each completion immediately streams
a ``status`` event, then we batch a single DB UPDATE per provider at
the end so subsequent ``GET /providers`` already shows fresh values.

Event shape::

    { "provider_id": str, "status": "online"|"abnormal"|"offline",
      "checked_at": ISO8601 }

A final ``done`` event terminates the stream.

DeployAuxModel.title: DeployAuxModel
DeployAuxModel.description:
An auxiliary task assignment to push via ``/api/model/set``.

``task`` is one of hermes' auxiliary task names (``vision``,
``web_extract``, ``compression`` etc). The deploy step calls
``set_model_assignment(scope="auxiliary", task=task, provider, model)``
once per entry. Tasks the user leaves at "跟随主模型" are simply
omitted from this list so hermes' existing assignment is left alone.

DeployMainModel.title: DeployMainModel
DeployMainModel.description:
The main model selection for ``POST /providers/deploy``.

``provider`` matches the ``name`` we will write into the new
``custom_providers[].name`` entries — i.e. the NineClaw-WebUI
Provider.name. ``model`` is the model id (one of that provider's
models). The wizard's step 3 picker is constrained to (provider, model)
pairs drawn from the providers selected in step 1.

main_model.description: Main model to write into config.model. Optional: when null the deployment only refreshes custom_providers and leaves the instance's existing main model selection alone.

auxiliary_models.title: Auxiliary Models
auxiliary_models.description: Optional auxiliary task assignments. Each entry triggers one /api/model/set call with scope='auxiliary'. Empty list keeps hermes' existing assignments untouched.

Either ``api_key`` or ``provider_id`` must resolve to a usable secret.
Empty ``api_key`` plus a ``provider_id`` belonging to the caller's
tenant means "use the stored key for that provider".
